description.value: The Fernie Fox Hotel is an eco-conscious property on the Crowsnest Highway in Fernie, BC, with a stated goal of becoming the most sustainable hotel in British Columbia, running much of its daily operations on solar energy and offering a free on-site EV charging station. It positions itself as a base for Fernie's world-class mountain biking and outdoor adventure, with pet-friendly rooms, a private balcony per room, and a secure on-site dog park. The hotel operates a dedicated e-bike section on its website, suggesting cyclist-specific services beyond the standard amenity set.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is substantive and confirms an active, open hotel. OSM phone (+1-250-423-6788) differs from the website header number (250) 400-630, and OSM email (stay@ferniefoxhotel.com) differs from the website email (contact@theferniefox.com) — both flagged. Secure bike storage is not explicitly described in the fetched pages; however, the navigation includes a dedicated 'Ebike Fernie Hotel' page whose content was not retrieved, so bike-related criteria remain null. Wi-Fi is positively confirmed as 'Unrestricted FREE Wi-Fi', and nearby food is supported by the hotel's breakfast-discount partnership with local restaurants and the site's description of Fernie's dining scene.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, open hotel in Fernie with a live booking system and substantial web presence; a clear and useful stop for touring cyclists in the Kootenays.
